Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
At 9:00 last night I got my Sabbat cards. A guy from a store in
Pasadena drove to his distributor at about 7:00 PM last night and picked
them up!

Well since I actually have the cards and many of you are just reading
the spoiler I'll comment on the look.

WOW! I'm just blown away by the art. Great package design and the
cards are beautiful. It is just plain freakish to pick up a booster
with almost 30 cards in it. Overall I'm pleased with the set. They
seem to have taken a lot more care with the wording of some cards and
even took the time to make some reprinted cards more clear. HOWEVER, I
am finding that the game is degenerating into a game of trumps! They
added (another) OOT Master that can be used as defense against some more
of the offensive trumps. [SARCASM ON] Thanks guys. That's just what we
wanted. [SARCASM OFF]

OK now to some card comments. I see that many of you are studying
carefully before commenting but I think I'm ready with a few now.

THE TREMERE CONSPIRACY!
=======================
It's true, there is a conspiracy. _Shotgun Ritual_ is as we expected.
Pay 2 blood to do a second round strike in the first round. Next is
_Eldritch Glimmer_:Thaum, Strike. Inferior 2R Damage AND can burn X
blood for +X damage. The superior starts at 4R damage. There are many
more to add. Take a look at Reverend Blackwood for example. I'll let
others add to this list becuase I'm at work and can't do this all day.

UNBLOCKABILITY!
===============
An alarming trend first begun with Horrific Countenance. In the
beginning there was only Day Operation. Now they've added Walk Through
Arcardia. A Malkavian Action Modifier. Costs 1 blood to play. Text
is: "Flip a Coin. If it comes up heads, this action is _unblockable_.
If it comes up tales the Malk. takes one unpreventable damage." Are
they insane. 1 damage is no risk at all. We don't even get the
advantage of trying to jam the Malk bleeder by not letting him cycle his
stealth. This can be played at will.
There is also an equipment that can be used once to make an action
ublockable. I think there is also another modifier somewhere in this
damn list. Anyway, this is really getting sick. Enough of the
unblockable crap!

COMBAT!
=======
Heavy combat influence. That seems fine to me. I think combat needed
the boost.

SUBTLETY!
=========
I've always been in favor of this one. Many of the cards are slight
variations of Jyhad cards. Forced Awakening and Redirection are 2 good
examples. When mixing sets we'll be debating whether the lack of cost
of Redirection is worth the restrictions on when it can be played. I'll
probably continue using wakes and will mix in Forced Awakenings also.

ATTACKS ON MASTER CARDS!
========================
Ok, so this is a small one and not that big a deal. But it bugs me.
Master Cards are often necessary to fix some of the basic inequities of
the vamps created for each clan as well as allowing some of the more
creative decks to be made. This has just gotten more difficult to do.

ERRORS!
======

White Phosphorus Grenade. Weapon: Burn After _USE_. Does 2R aggravated
_EACH STRIKE_. How do you do additional strikes? It should burn after
the first one is resolved. Shouldn't it?

Ok that's all for now. But I'll be back!

Robert

Messages.Author: Scott Whittaker
Messages.Body:
I hope you enjoy the art. IMHO, after scrutinizing the spoiler list,
Sabbat is a load of .... silly trump cards that destroy game balance and
pushess *many* previously viable strategies to the asheap. Does anyone
think that Settites can ever survive and prosper?
So gaze at the cards, appreciate the art, and lock them up somewhere.
The people that I play with will gladly ignore this expansion and play
the old game.
Sean (aka Scott) Whittaker

Messages.Author: Bernard M. Bresnahan
Messages.Body:
My take on the 2R - Aggravated each strike is based on the WOTC ruling
that if someone
decides to use a Bomb or Grenade in combat, and your opponent uses S:CE
or Dodge, then
the Bomb or Grenade wasn't used (as there was no actual target/excuse to
use the weapon).
Now lets say I'm using the White Phosphorous grenade and my opponent
tries to use a dodge.
I could then blur for an additional strike to use the WP:Grenade to full
effect.

Hmmm, in hindsight then you really wouldn't need the errata on the
card. Though for those
who might not be aware of the ruling, it would probably help others
determine something similar
to what I described above.

- Bernie
